title: FE Console Spam
features:
spam warnings in other people's consoles, harmless but funny.

Credits to 7GrandDad, not my script.
script:
local customMessage = 'anticheat developers be dammed'

repeat
    local char = game:GetService('Players').LocalPlayer.Character
    local animator = char and char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('Animator', true) or nil
   
    if animator then
        local anim = Instance.new('Animation')
        anim.AnimationId = 'http=507770677\1'..Random.new():NextInteger(1, 1000000)..'\n'..customMessage..'\n'
        local loaded = animator:LoadAnimation(anim)
        loaded:Play(0, 0.0001, 0)
    end
   
    task.wait()
until false
